answer: Each fake identity must plant one violet in its own garden bed along the horizon, paying the k-th Catalan number of cuttings: 1, 2, 5, 14, 42. Ten fakes cost 23,713 cuttings and a hundred cost over 10^57, since each new bed branches four ways. Two violets sharing one bed choke each other and both die at the close, so clones cannot split one bed's toll.
